findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "polymarket_top" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: The most active Polymarket markets right now (by 24h volume, liquidity or 24h change; optional tag like crypto/fed/politics): question, YES odds, 24h change, vo…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pulse · Private data: explain, token_verdict, oracle_forecast, polymarket_edge, oracle_track_record · Public sink: token_verdict · Destructive: sources_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pulse · Private data: explain, token_verdict, oracle_forecast, polymarket_edge, oracle_track_record · Public sink: token_verdict · Destructive: sources_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
